observationUnit: participant navigation, clustered in simultaneous waves
limitations: Local warm server/database; cold means a fresh browser context and unvisited destination.
One and four users; not a production capacity or sustained-load test.
Each reviewer has the same 24 non-overlapping bookings in three owner-attested rooms; published slot-panel versions are not represented.
An 8-connection limit applies per Prisma client, not globally to every server process or service.
Database sampler observes same-role backends except itself; 50 ms sampling can miss short waits and is not a Prisma queue measurement.
DOM readiness plus two animation frames is a paint proxy; four-user observations share browser/CPU and wave.
Reference cohorts run before current cohorts; not a randomized crossover.
Browser error counts cover each page lifetime, including initial page load and warm-up; they are not localized to the measured destination click.
The raw membersPerClub=61 describes the base fixture; three verified reviewers increase the active club to 64 members.
The initial incomplete four-user reference run and two smoke runs are preserved outside the primary groups.
